One-time-code input

Source: R/tier2-input-otp.R
shad_input_otp.Rd

A shadcn OTP input: one real hidden input overlays a row of rendered cells. input$<inputId> is the string as typed (may be partial).

Usage

shad_input_otp(
  inputId,
  length = 6,
  groups = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  pattern = c("numeric", "alphanumeric"),
  disabled = FALSE,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

inputId

Input id.

length

Total number of cells / code length.

groups

Optional integer vector splitting cells into groups separated by a divider (e.g. c(3, 3)). Must sum to length.

label

Optional label (wraps in shad_form_field()).

pattern

"numeric" (digits only) or "alphanumeric" (any character).

disabled

If TRUE, disables the control.

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

Extra attributes on the OTP root.

Value

An OTP input tag.

See also

Other shadshiny tier-2 components: shad_calendar(), shad_checkbox(), shad_combobox(), shad_date_picker(), shad_form_field(), shad_input(), shad_input_group(), shad_native_select(), shad_radio_group(), shad_select(), shad_slider(), shad_switch(), shad_textarea(), shad_toggle(), shad_toggle_group()

Examples

shad_input_otp("code", length = 6, groups = c(3, 3))
#> <div class="shad-otp" data-shad="input-otp" id="code" data-length="6" data-pattern="\d">
#>   <input class="shad-otp__input" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code" aria-label="One-time code"/>
#>   <div class="shad-otp__group">
#>     <div class="shad-otp__cell" aria-hidden="true"></div>
#>     <div class="shad-otp__cell" aria-hidden="true"></div>
#>     <div class="shad-otp__cell" aria-hidden="true"></div>
#>   </div>
#>   <div class="shad-otp__separator" aria-hidden="true"><svg class="shad-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/></svg></div>
#>   <div class="shad-otp__group">
#>     <div class="shad-otp__cell" aria-hidden="true"></div>
#>     <div class="shad-otp__cell" aria-hidden="true"></div>
#>     <div class="shad-otp__cell" aria-hidden="true"></div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
